modalities.evidence: positron emission tomography (PET) with the radiotracer [11C]Martinostat

output.population: Patients diagnosed with chronic low back pain, no healthy controls; 25 participants
output.summary: Observational cross-sectional multimodal neuroimaging in patients with chronic low back pain: [11C]Martinostat PET, structural MRI (T1w, T2w, FLAIR) and resting-state functional MRI, with no task or intervention.
